# Terrain — Life Sciences Market Intelligence Platform
# https://terrain.ambrosiaventures.co
# Built by Ambrosia Ventures

## What Terrain Is
Terrain is a market intelligence platform for biopharma, medtech, and diagnostics professionals. It provides indication-level market sizing, competitive landscape analysis, regulatory pathway assessment, partner mapping, and live market intelligence across 18 therapeutic areas and 236+ indications.

## Therapeutic Areas Covered (18)
Oncology, Neurology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Cardiovascular, Metabolic, Psychiatry, Pain Management, Infectious Disease, Hematology, Ophthalmology, Pulmonology, Nephrology, Dermatology, Gastroenterology, Endocrinology, Urology, Hepatology

## Core Modules
1. Market Sizing — Patient funnel-based TAM/SAM/SOM with biomarker nesting, treatment line modeling, payer mix, biosimilar erosion, IRA impact, geographic decomposition, and DCF waterfall
2. Competitive Landscape — Threat assessment, displacement risk, mechanism analysis, patent cliff analysis, efficacy deltas. Specialized engines for pharma, medtech, CDx, and nutraceutical
3. Partner Analysis — Strategic adjacency scoring across 300+ potential partners
4. Regulatory Analysis — Pathway analysis, LOA by phase and TA, designation impact modeling
5. Live Market Intelligence — Real-time AI-powered intelligence with signal classification (competitive, regulatory, clinical, deal, market)

## Data Sources
- ClinicalTrials.gov (daily refresh)
- FDA Drug Approvals (daily refresh)
- SEC EDGAR full-text search (weekly)
- 2,100+ competitor entries across 14 specialized databases
- 400+ deal comparables
- 550+ pricing benchmarks
- Biomarker prevalence data
- LOA tables sourced from BIO/Informa/QLS + CDER/CBER 2021-2025
- AI-enriched data rotating across all 18 TAs

## Who Uses Terrain
- Business development teams at pharma and biotech companies
- Strategy and corporate development professionals
- VC and CVC operating partners evaluating portfolio company markets
- Biotech founders preparing for partnering or fundraising
- Regulatory affairs professionals assessing development pathways
